label: PMO Framework Design
description: Designs Project Management Office (PMO) framework including governance structure, methodology standards, reporting cadence, tooling requirements, and capability development plan.

claudeKnowledge.description: PMO design frameworks, PRINCE2, PMI PMBOK, agile at scale, portfolio management, governance design

guidedInputs.label: Organisation context
guidedInputs.placeholder:
Describe the organisation: size, industry, current state of project management maturity, number of active projects/programmes, and what is driving the need for a PMO.
e.g. Nordic financial services firm, 1 200 employees, 20 active projects, no formal PMO exists. Currently running 3 major regulatory programmes (DORA, AMLR, CSRD) concurrently. Project managers exist within business units but no central standards or governance.

options.label: Controlling PMO — standards compliance, reviews, reporting
Centre of Excellence — capability building, methodology
Portfolio PMO — portfolio prioritisation and resource allocation

guidedInputs.label: Existing project management practices
guidedInputs.placeholder: Describe what is already in place: methodologies used (waterfall/agile/hybrid), tools (Jira, MS Project, etc.), reporting processes, and any formal standards.

guidedInputs.label: Key challenges to address
guidedInputs.placeholder:
What problems should the PMO solve? What pain points are driving this initiative?
e.g. Projects consistently over budget, no portfolio visibility for executive team, resource conflicts between projects, inconsistent reporting making it impossible to compare project status.

guidedInputs.label: Constraints
guidedInputs.placeholder:
Budget, headcount, timeline, technology, or political constraints on the PMO design.
e.g. PMO must be operational within 3 months, maximum 3 FTE headcount, existing tooling (Jira + Confluence) must be leveraged.

guidedInputs.label: PMO leadership
guidedInputs.placeholder: Who will lead the PMO? What is their background and experience level? e.g. Head of Delivery, 10 years PM experience, no previous PMO leadership.
